title: fix(doctor): scope the placeholder scanner to IDD-managed files, not the whole repo
body:
## Goal

Fix `idd-doctor.mjs`'s `{{...}}` placeholder scanner so it stays scoped to
IDD-managed files, matching its own pass-message claim ("no unresolved
`{{...}}` placeholders in IDD-managed files"), instead of scanning every
git-tracked text-like file in the adopter repository.

## Background

Discovered 2026-08-15 while running the v0.6.0 re-import verification in
[`kurone-kito/kit.black`](https://github.com/kurone-kito/kit.black) (issue
kurone-kito/kit.black#128). `node scripts/idd-doctor.mjs` reports:

```text
ERROR unresolved placeholders found: packages/web/src/i18n/en.ts: {{ year }} | packages/web/src/i18n/ja.ts: {{ year }}
```

`packages/web/src/i18n/{en,ja}.ts` are the adopter's own application i18n
dictionaries. `{{ year }}` there is a legitimate runtime template token the
app's own translator substitutes at render time — it has nothing to do with
IDD onboarding placeholders and was never meant to be "resolved" by import.

## Root cause

`checkPlaceholders` (`scripts/idd-doctor.mjs`) receives `files` from
`listFiles(root)` → `git ls-files --cached --others --exclude-standard`,
filtered only by `isTextLikeFile` (`/\.(md|txt|yml|yaml|json|mjs|js|ts|sh)$/`)
in the caller (`runDoctor`, around line 42: `const textFiles =
files.filter(isTextLikeFile);`). `checkPlaceholders`'s own
`excludedPrefixes` list only removes `idd-template/`, `fixtures/`,
`tests/fixtures/`, `tests/`, `.git/` (plus `.github/instructions/` and
`audit/` under `distributionSource`) — there is no scoping to IDD-managed
paths (`.github/instructions/`, `docs/`, `profiles/`, `.claude/skills/`,
the vendored `scripts/`/`schemas/` bundle, etc.). Every other `.ts`/`.js`/
`.md`/`.json`/`.yml` file in the adopter's own application source is
scanned too, so any adopter that legitimately uses `{{...}}` as a runtime
template syntax (i18n, mustache-style templates, etc.) trips this check.

The function's own doc comment and pass message both say "IDD-managed
files" / "unresolved placeholders in IDD-managed files" — the code does
not actually implement that scope.

## Proposed change

Scope `checkPlaceholders` to only the paths `idd-doctor` itself treats as
IDD-managed (the same file classes `checkRequiredFiles` cares about, plus
`.github/instructions/`, `profiles/`, `.claude/skills/`, the vendored
`scripts/`/`schemas/`/`fixtures/schemas/` bundle, and `docs/*.md`), rather
than every text-like file in the repository. Add a regression fixture
under an adopter-style path outside that scope (e.g. a `.ts` file with a
`{{ token }}` template placeholder) to `tests/fixtures/` to lock the fix.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `checkPlaceholders` only scans IDD-managed paths, not the full
      adopter-repository file tree.
- [ ] A regression test fixture (a non-IDD-managed file containing a
      `{{...}}`-shaped token) passes cleanly.
- [ ] Existing IDD-managed-file placeholder detection (including inside
      `.github/instructions/*.md` marker examples) still fires as before.
- [ ] `docs/idd-policy.md`-style downstream adopters relying on `node
      scripts/idd-doctor.mjs` exiting clean no longer need a manual
      disposition note for this false positive.

## Downstream reference

kurone-kito/kit.black#128 disposition (record-and-route, no local patch —
`scripts/idd-doctor.mjs` is vendored byte-identical from this repository
and a local patch would silently revert on the next re-sync).
